review.summary: Phase 27 delivers the TypeScript 0.35.0 directional-profile addition additively and verifiably. I independently confirmed the pinned upstream shapes, a mechanically derived 12-node closure, 16 added graph nodes / 8 roots with byte-identical history, exactly five optional projections with lossless typed-wins behaviour, two request-root repoints in profiles.rs with frozen response roots, a real 906-case Zod corpus (231 accepted) replayed from Rust, and honest docs on both validation directions. All 101 recorded checks exit 0 on reviewed SHA a04d4f9 in one 10:53–11:10 window, including both compilers, the executed example, the TLS lockfile patches and a current-source bounded read-only receipt. Every attempt-3 finding is closed with enforcing regressions, and the review-tool snapshot bug is fixed with four targeted tests. One low remains: per-operation test attribution is asserted by a hand-written table.

findings.description: The corrected per-operation evidence attribution is asserted against a hardcoded table (create/update -> WIRE_TESTS[:3], get -> [0], list* -> [0],[3]) and tools/typescript035_profiles.py:79-83 only checks that each wire test name exists exactly once in management_contracts.rs. I verified the current attribution is accurate (directional_profiles_preserve_all_wire_paths_and_both_response_policies calls create/update/list_for_token/list/get/list_all at management_contracts.rs:1766-1831; current_profile_requests_reject... and valid_raw_directional_extensions... call only create/update; profile_wire_defaults... calls only list_for_token/list/list_all). Nothing, however, ties a cited row to the client methods a test body actually invokes, so removing a call from a test keeps the operation-mapping, qualification and export ledgers claiming evidence that no longer exists.
findings.required_fix: Derive each operation's directional test set from the test bodies (e.g. extract the `client.<method>(`/`profiles().<method>(` calls inside each #[tokio::test] function and require the cited rows to match) instead of comparing against a hand-maintained table.

evidence: Prior findings closed on current source: contracts/native-operation-mappings/management.json now cites profile_wire_defaults_and_empty_terminal_pages_follow_request_options only on list (725), listAll (743) and listForToken (763), with create (628-633), update and get (685-688) narrowed to tests that actually invoke them; crates/scm-sdk/tests/typescript035_models.rs:32-85 replaces the `starts_with("ContentType")` heuristic with an explicit 8-root table of registry name plus mode list and asserts len==8; tools/test_model_fixtures.py:10,32-34 imports SDK_MAINTENANCE_BASELINE and passes timeout=30 to the git subprocess; tools/verify_typescript035_source.py:20-29 adds verify_model_imports, called from verify() at :232 before any oracle copy/import, with seven negative cases in tools/test_typescript035_source.py:18-29; tools/check_phase.py:329-332 applies the `if command not in commands` dedupe to glob-expanded unittest commands, and the receipt now records test_review_phase.py, test_management_phases.py, test_red_team_management.py, test_management_consumers.py, test_management_fixtures.py and test_red_team_management_models.py exactly once each (101 commands, down from 107).

Review-tool correction and its regressions: tools/review_phase.py:201-234 accepts an archived command policy only when archived_sha256 is supplied, the source is not current, and sha256(snapshot)==record['checks_sha256'] (itself validated at :321-327), while current source still requires [item['command'] for item in checks] == commands_for(phase) plus verify_checkpoint_bindings for phases 23-27. tools/test_review_phase.py:426-451 proves current source must satisfy today's policy, historical chunk and phase records survive deduplication and later command additions, an emptied archived snapshot is rejected, and direct check_evidence never gains snapshot trust; :689-710 covers the fifth-chunk follow-up plus predecessor policy change. Recorded 'Ran 52 tests ... OK' (docs/reviews/phase-27-attempt-04.checks.json:236).

Overlay matches the pinned upstream exactly and is derived, not asserted: contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0/src/models/mgmt-security-profile.ts:239-246 (four optional protections + .passthrough()), :262-269 (four direction keys), :272 (ModelConfigurationSchema = ContentTypeConfigurationSchema.extend), :276, :288-289, :334 and the CreateSecurityProfileRequest dlp_tenant_id occurrence. tools/typescript035_profiles.py:95-103 expands the ancestor closure from the five projection owners and raises 'Unreviewed TypeScript profile ancestor closure' unless it equals the 12 reviewed clones; :104-107 re-checks the six frozen root identities; :113-116 rejects any protection key absent from frozen s009588; :147-169 clones, remaps, adds exactly four overlay nodes plus eight roots and fails on any changed historical node.

Generated Rust is correct and additive: crates/scm-sdk/src/models/generated.rs:4457-4560 shows AiSecurityProfile with Optional<String> content_type_mode and Optional<ContentTypeConfigurations>, a custom Deserialize that re-inserts an undecodable value as a raw extension (:4471-4490), KNOWN excluding projection keys (:4519) and extension skipping only when the typed field is set (:4548-4557); :13369-13383 and :13493ff declare both new types with the four reused protection types, flattened Extensions and redacted Debug (:13481-13486, :13597-13602); 153638 and 168370 carry the remaining projections. tools/generate_models.py:471-506 is the pre-existing generic mechanism, and generate_models.py --check passed with {outputs 20, graphNodes 13018} (checks:1749).

Additivity proven against Git baseline bytes: tools/test_typescript035_implementation.py:26-36 freezes typescript.json/operations.json/manifest.json/export-classification/native-union-variants and every baseline fixture except model-regressions.json; :38-54 proves native-fixtures/schemas.json differs only in provenance.generatorSha256 and model-regressions.json only in provenance.sha256/oracleSha256, each bound to current bytes; :68-77 proves profiles.rs changed exactly the two request-schema arguments with identical .named() lists (confirmed: profiles.rs:91,214 versioned, response roots 76,92,107,215,231 frozen); :91-111 proves the lockfile changed only rustls-webpki 0.103.15->0.103.16 and webpki-root-certs 1.0.9->1.0.10 and that the dependency audit precedes the first Rust command; :113-128 requires every historical node/root to survive and the committed graph to equal Overlay.extend_graph(baseline). I independently confirmed 8 new roots in schema_graph.json and exactly one s_ts035 alias in semantics.json, with validation/tests.rs:209-220 asserting 70 semantics, [] insertion in Response and omission in ResponseWithoutDefaults.

Executed Zod oracle, independently recounted: I counted 906 case ids matching `^      "id": "<Root>Schema:` and 231 "success": true entries in contracts/typescript-035-oracle.json, equal to the recorded {"roots":8,"cases":906,"accepted":231} (checks:2719). tools/typescript035-oracle.mts:19 runs the source verifier before copying, :22-25 rejects installed Zod differing from tools/package-lock.json, :34 substitutes placeholder DLP identifier '100'. typescript035_models.rs:32-45 replays the two new roots in Request, Response and ResponseWithoutDefaults; the Request-only scope for the six versioned roots is recorded in contracts/typescript-035-parity.json:177.

Wire behaviour is exercised on real paths: management_contracts.rs:1736-1839 drives POST /v1/mgmt/profile, PUT /v1/mgmt/profile/uuid/{ID}, list_for_token, list, get and a two-page list_all for defaults true and false against a reply with null dlp_tenant_id, integer tool-call and null inspection, asserting byte-equal round-trips; :1842-1873 sends 5 pointers x 3 invalid values through create and update asserting ErrorKind::Validation with token.calls==0 and wire.requests==0; :1876-1982 proves raw .extension() requests serialize identically and decode into typed projections including nested tool-response app-protection.

Evidence is complete, source-bound and fresh: docs/reviews/phase-27-attempt-04.checks.json records phase 27, source_sha256 a04d4f9 (the reviewed SHA), source_unchanged true, passed true, 101 checks; I counted 101 "exit_code": 0 occurrences, zero "timeout": true, zero "source_unchanged": false, and all 101 executed_at values inside 2026-10-22T10:53:39-11:10:59, so no --resume prefix was reused. Key outputs: verify_typescript035_source.py 'Verified TypeScript 0.35.0 source inputs' (:2659); typescript035_profiles.py {addedExports 4, addedModels 2, addedSchemas 2, projectedFields 5, versionedRoots 6, clonedNodes 12, defaultAliases 1} (:2679); generate_validation.py '69 explicit bindings' (:1729); response_defaults.py {defaultBindings 23} (:1789); model_fixtures.py {specimens 18} (:1809); red_team_management.py --check --current-source-compatibility 'current-source compatibility and bounded reads verified; release acceptance not assessed' (:281); check-private-material receiptFresh true with 2364 files (:257); tsc --strict on the oracle (:2757); both check-rust management runs on 1.89.0 and 1.99.0 executing fmt/check/clippy -D warnings/test/test --examples/doc/run --example directional_profiles, all exit 0 (:2789, :2821).

Honest live and release scoping: docs/checks/phase-27-live-attempt-05.json is a schemaVersion-2 read-only receipt with mutationsEnabled false, one OAuth success, four 403 target-list probes and an explicit exercised-endpoint limitation; tools/live_evidence.py:301 requires runtimeInputsSha256 == runtime_fingerprint() and :313-315 requires that endpoint limitation for phase-27/28 receipts; tools/red_team_management.py:792-819,864-876 makes --current-source-compatibility require that fresh receipt plus cumulative offline qualification with package receipts excluded. docs/PHASES.md:283-289 defers clean extracted package consumers to phase 28, matching commands_for(27). CHANGELOG.md:17-41, docs/STABILITY.md:36-53, docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md:97-138 and docs/RESPONSE_DEFAULTS.md:48-51 disclose the intentional request tightening, the frozen tolerant response path, typed-over-extension precedence, the unchanged [] default and the unverified directional live status.

Contract completeness is enforced structurally: tools/check_phase.py:27-85 requires a declared owner and an executed owning check for every contracts/*.json in scope, and tools/test_management_phases.py:190-206 runs that over the active phase 27 scope plus both failure modes (recorded 'Ran 27 tests ... OK', including test_phase27_unittest_discovery_runs_each_suite_once, checks:204). tools/test_g25.py:14-21 pins the 190-row frozen format inventory digest and excludes typescript:/vendor: roots, so the overlay cannot inflate historical G25 coverage; contracts/compatibility/g25/audit.json:22 changes only the schema_graph input hash.
limitations: Read-only Read/Glob/Grep only: I could not recompute any SHA-256, run git, or re-execute any check, test, generator, oracle or compiler. Pass/fail conclusions rest on the recorded commands, invocations, exit codes, stdout/stderr and executed_at values in docs/reviews/phase-27-attempt-04.checks.json, cross-read against the artifacts those commands own.

I did not execute tools/check_phase.py, so I could not prove by execution that the 101 recorded commands are literally commands_for(27). I read the derivation at check_phase.py:318-356, confirmed each required owner is present with exit code 0, and relied on review_phase.check_evidence:227 enforcing that equality for current source at record time.

crates/scm-sdk/src/validation/schema_graph.json and semantics.json are single-line minified artifacts; I verified the eight new roots, the two new node names and the single alias by targeted grep plus the generator reconstruction path and the Python/Rust regressions, not by reading them end to end. contracts/native-models.json, native-operations.json, qualification.json, native-exports.json, response-defaults.json, typescript.json and the g25 artifacts were spot-checked at the relevant sections only.

The frozen schema oracle and verify-contracts.py --baseline are recorded as invoked through the optional .local/typescript checkout; per instructions I treated those recorded outputs as evidence without inspecting that checkout. I read no credential or tenant-registration files and made no network calls.

Zod-to-Rust equivalence remains Mode::Request only for the six versioned roots (deliberate and recorded at contracts/typescript-035-parity.json:177); the two new roots replay all three modes. I recounted the 906 cases and 231 accepted outcomes in the committed corpus but did not re-derive Zod's outcomes.

The current live receipt (executed 06:57Z) predates the 10:53Z check run; it is bound by runtime fingerprint (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, LICENSE, NOTICE, src and examples), which the attempt-4 corrections did not touch, so live_evidence.py --check legitimately passes. Directional create/update remain live-unverified and I did not assess service behaviour.

I judged phase-27 acceptance only. Clean extracted package consumers, 0.2.4 readiness, registry bytes, annotated tag and remote CI are phase-28 scope. I did not re-audit the frozen 0.34.0 baseline, phase 19-25 infrastructure or the 0.2.3 release receipts beyond the identity checks this overlay depends on. Phase 27's chunk entries in docs/phase-status.json are still 'pending' because review_phase.accepted_chunks reconciles them at advancement; both fifth-attempt chunk reviews (46/50 models, 45/50 wire) were recorded at the earlier source 93d22ec, and I assessed the intervening corrections directly against current source.
